Area.evidence_source: Approximately one-third of prisoners had explicitly told someone (for example, a family member or psychiatrist) of their wish to die. Two (3%) prisoners said that they had made ambiguous references to family that they might take their own lives. Table 3. Categories of images reported during the near-lethal suicide attempts. Image of/that... Yourself planning/preparing to harm yourself or make a suicide attempt. The things you were escaping from by attempting suicide. What might happen to you if you died. What might happen to other people if you died. A real event that happened to you (e.g. a traumatic event but not suicide or self-harm). A memory of a time you tried to harm yourself in the past. Made you feel safe or better. 'I saw a picture of my father and mother'. (Case 51)
